note: Corps of Engineers campground beside Wappapello Dam, in two paved full-hookup loops on wooded hills: East, in a hollow behind the dam-area day use, and West, on a hillside above a lake cove with timber between the sites and the water. Visitor center, beach, boat ramp and the Lake View Trail are in the day-use area. --Claude
summary: Open: the West loop is selling now and through the winter on recreation.gov; the East loop closed for the season in early November and reopens May 5, 2027. Full hookups, 50A, $28 peak / $24 off-peak (as stored), 14-night limit, 2-night weekend minimum. The stored note's 'FCFS off-peak' is no longer so - winter nights are reservable - and the note is rewritten. No site shows the lake: waterfront lead down. Pin is in the day-use area by the dam, 550-1000 m from the loops - move flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN (stored lakeview; lead: not waterfront): recreation.gov's per-site coordinates on leaf-off imagery put the East loop (62 entries, sites 046-107) in a wooded hollow 450-700 m east of the lake with a ridge and the day-use area between - no water in sight. The West loop (34 entries, sites 001-040) is on a timbered hillside; its outermost sites (022, 023, 024) are about 110-140 m from the edge of a narrow cove with unbroken hardwood between, and the rest are farther. recreation.gov's spring photos of sites 015, 021, 022, 023 and 024 show the pad backed by woods with no water visible; no site carries a 'Proximity to Water' attribute and the facility text claims a lake view only for the Lake View Trail. With no site that can be shown to see the lake, the value goes down to not waterfront under the 2026-11-02 rule.

PIN MOVE: stored 36.9274,-90.2838 is recreation.gov's facility point, on the lake-side tip beside the dam and gatehouse - day use, no camping. The loops: West (the year-round one) centre 36.91843,-90.28689, about 1.0 km south-south-west of the stored pin; East centre 36.9223,-90.2830, about 570 m south. Suggested pin: East loop (the larger), 36.9223,-90.2830; or the West loop if the year-round loop is preferred.

WINTER ARRANGEMENT: the stored note said 'reservable in peak season, FCFS off-peak'. The calendar now sells the West loop's 34 sites for every winter night sampled (November 2026 to April 2027) at the $24 off-peak rate; the East loop's sites are marked Closed for those months. I cleared fcfs (written null) because nothing read says walk-up sites are held; the facility's reservationCutOff rule is 0.

SITE COUNT: 109 is the Corps' figure in the facility text and is what is stored. The catalog has 96 bookable standard entries (several are doubles such as 19/20, 25/26 and 56/61, sold at $48 / $40); I kept 109.
SEASON: stored year_round (derived from the calendar) is right for the West loop only; season.note says so.
MINIMUM STAY: recreation.gov's rules carry a 2-night weekend minimum (no end date). Written to booking.min_stay; it is a weekend rule, not a standing minimum.
PHONE: none stored. recreation.gov: (573) 222-8233 while the gatehouse is staffed (April 2 to October 28, 2026), (573) 778-5404 otherwise; Wappapello Lake management office 573-222-7500.
UNREAD: the Corps' own Wappapello Lake pages (mvs.usace.army.mil) were not fetched; everything is from recreation.gov and imagery. No flood or closure notice is on the recreation.gov record.
MILITARY: recreation.gov's militaryDiscount rule is present; not written as a discount.
